# Generated WASM32 runtime

This directory is generated by `bash wasm/build.sh`.

- `rioos.wasm` — compiled MyKernel WASM32 module.
- `index.html` — browser terminal.
- `ui.html` — browser framebuffer UI.

Do not edit generated pages here; edit their source in `wasm/` and rebuild. Object files under `obj/` are temporary build products.
